accountConnect.account: Kāore he pūkete e hiahiatia ana mō te tirotiro tūmatanui. Whakapāngia tō pūkete DeHub hei whakahaere i tō kōtaha me te hanga, te whakaputa ihirangi rānei.
accountConnect.body: Whakapāngia tō pūkete hei whakahaere i tō kōtaha, hei whakaputa pou me te hanga ihirangi mai i te kōrerorero. Ka pau ngā hononga i roto i te 24 hāora. Ka taea e koe te momotu i ngā wā katoa.
accountConnect.failed: Kāore i taea te whakaoti i te hononga. Me ngana ki te waitohu anō.
accountConnect.generate: Hangaia he pāpāho mā te whakamahi i ō whiwhinga, ngā utu kua whakamanahia, ngā whakaahua kore utu rānei e tika ana
accountConnect.generatePrompt: Whakaaturia mai ngā tauira whakaahua o DeHub ki ahau me te whakahua i tētahi whakaahua i mua i te hanga.
accountConnect.intro: Tirotirohia a DeHub i roto i te ChatGPT, honoa rānei tō ake pūkete hei whakahou i tō kōtaha, hei whakaputa pou me te whakamahi i te Creator Studio. Tāpirihia te https://dehub.io/mcp hei tūhono OAuth mō ngā mana whakahaere pūkete.
accountConnect.libraryPrompt: Whakaaturia ngā rawa hou i roto i taku whare pukapuka Kaihanga DeHub.
accountConnect.profile: Whakatikahia tō kōtaha, ngā whakaahua me ngā tautuhinga tūmataiti
accountConnect.profilePrompt: Whakahōutia taku koiora DeHub ki: He kaihanga motuhake e hanga ana i ngā kiriata me te puoro.
accountConnect.read: Pānuihia tō pūkete, ngā pou, ngā whakamōhiotanga me te whare pukapuka Kaihanga
accountConnect.social: Whakaputaina ngā pou me ngā tākupu, whāia ngā tāngata me te tiaki tohuwāhi
accountConnect.step: Mō ngā mana whakahaere pūkete, tāpirihia te https://dehub.io/mcp hei tūhono OAuth, waitohu ki DeHub me te arotake i ngā whakaaetanga i mua i te tuku urunga.
accountConnect.title: Whakapāngia tō pūkete DeHub
accountConnect.what: Tirotirohia ngā pou tūmatanui me ngā kōtaha. Mā te hononga pūkete OAuth, whakahaerehia tō kōtaha me tō tūmataiti, whakaputaina ngā pou me ngā tākupu, whāia ngā tāngata, pānuihia ngā whakamōhiotanga, tiakina ngā tohuwāhi me te hanga whakaahua, ataata, oro me ngā rawa 3D. Ka whakamahia e te hanga ngā ture utu o DeHub.

workspace.moderationHelp: Whakahohea te whakaaetanga whakahaere i te tuatahi. Me noho kē te pūkete hei kaihanga o te pāho ora, hei kaiwhakahaere kua tohua rānei. Ka hāngai tonu ngā aratau whakaae tuatahi me te hukihuki anake. Ka pau aunoa ngā wā whakatā.

Kāore e taea te muku ngā tirohanga, ngā whakamōhiotanga kua tukuna, ngā whakawhitinga kua waihangatia, ngā whakaahua kōtaha me ngā wā whakatā kua pau. raffle.title: Nga utu
raffle.heroTitle: Ia utu, ka whakataua i runga i te mekameka.
raffle.heroBody: Ko ngā whakawhiwhinga tohu DeHub ka tohatoha i ngā tohu DeHub, taputapu me ngā taonga kohikohi ki ngā tāngata kua whakamahi kē i te papaa. Ka whiwhi ngā whakauru mā te whai wāhi, ka whakaputaina te rārangi whakauru i mua i te whakahaere o te whakawhiwhinga, ka tohua te toa mā te whakawhitiwhiti ka taea e te katoa te pānui.
raffle.seeHowItWorks: Tirohia me pēhea te mahi o te utu
raffle.findLiveDraw: Kimihia te utu ora i roto i tō pātaka.
raffle.noPurchase: Kāore he hoko e hiahiatia ana. Kei ia whakawhiwhinga te ara whakauru kore utu, ā, ki te tukua he tiikiti, kāore ia e te ara anake hei whakauru.
raffle.anatomyPrizeBody: Ka whakapuakihia i te whakatuwheratanga o te utu. E kore e whakarereketia i muri mai.
raffle.anatomyRoutesBody: Ka whakarārangihia katoatia, me te taumaha e mau ana ia mea.
raffle.anatomyClosingBody: He wā tūturu, ehara i te "ka oti ana mātou".
raffle.anatomySnapshotBody: Ka whakaputaina i mua i te whakahaerenga o te utu.
raffle.anatomyRandomnessBody: Ka tohua i runga i te mekameka, i roto i te tauwhitinga ka taea e koe te whakatuwhera.
raffle.anatomyClaimBody: 14 ngā rā mai i te hua whakaputa.
raffle.howTitle: Me pēhea te mahi o te utu
raffle.howBody: E whā ngā taahinga, i te raupapa kotahi, i ngā wā katoa. Ko ngā wāhanga e whakatau ana ko wai ka toa ka puta i te iwi.
raffle.step1Body: Ka whakatuwheratia ia utu me tōna utu, tōna wā kati me ngā huarahi tika ki te whiwhi whakauru, ka whakaputaina ki te taupānga, ka piri ki te pātaka.
raffle.step2Title: Ka kohia e koe ngā whakauru
raffle.step2Body: Ka whiwhi whakauru mā te mahi i ngā mea kua mahia e koe i runga i te DeHub. Ka whakaingoatia e te panuitanga ngā mahi e tatau ana mō taua utu, me te nui o te utu e mau ana ia mea.
raffle.step3Body: I te wā kati ka tangohia he tāhuhu o te rārangi whakauru, ka tohua te tauwāhi toa mai i tētahi pūtake matapōkere i runga i te mekameka, ehara i te ripanga.
raffle.step4Body: Ko te tāhuhu, te tauwhitinga me te whakauru toa ka puta tahi mai, kia taea ai e te katoa te tirotiro anō i te hua, kaua ki te tango i tā mātou kupu.
raffle.entriesTitle: Ka whiwhi whakauru, ehara i te hoko
raffle.entriesBody: Ka whai taumaha ngā utu ki te hunga e whakamahi ana i te DeHub. Ka whakaingoatia e ia panuitanga ngā huarahi e tatau ana mō taua mea. Ko ēnei ngā huarahi e hangaia ai ngā utu i te nuinga o te wā.
raffle.postBody: Ko ngā whakairinga taketake, ngā ataata me ngā kōrero ka tatau ki ngā rereretanga e whakaingoatia ai.
raffle.stakeBody: Ko te tūranga whakanoho tuwhera ka whiwhi urunga mō ngā rereretanga e taumaha ai.
raffle.arcadeBody: Ko ngā wāhanga arcade me ngā tūranga i runga i te papa whakataetae ka whangai i ngā rereretanga i hangaia huri noa i ngā kēmu.
raffle.stagesBody: Ko te tae atu ki ngā atamira oro ora ka tatau, ahakoa ka kōrero koe, ka whakarongo rānei.
raffle.ticketBody: Ko ētahi o ngā whakawhiwhinga ka hokona hoki he tiikiti i utua ki ngā tohu DeHub. Ki te pērā, ka whakaputaina te utu me te rohe mō ia pūkete i mua.
raffle.collectibleBody: Ko ngā kohinga NFT kua tohua ka mau i ngā urunga tuuturu ki ngā rereretanga e whakaingoatia ai.
raffle.fairnessTitle: He aha te hua ka taea te whakawhirinaki
raffle.fairnessBody: He whai hua anake te uru atu ki tētahi raffa ki te kore e taea e te kaiwhakahaere te kōwhiri puku i te toa. E toru ngā mea e pono ai tēnei ki konei.
raffle.fair1Title: Ka mau te rārangi i te tuatahi
raffle.fair1Body: Ka tangohia te rārangi urunga i te wā kati kua tohua, ka whakaputaina i mua i te whakahaere i te rereretanga. Karekau he mea ka taea te tāpiri i muri mai, tae atu ki a mātou.
raffle.fair2Title: Ko te matapōkere ka ahu mai i te mekameka
raffle.fair2Body: Ko te tauwāhi toa ka ahu mai i runga i te mekameka, nō reira ko te tau e whakatau ana i te rereretanga kei roto i tētahi whakawhitiwhiti tūmatanui, ehara i te taputapu ā-roto.
raffle.fair3Title: Ka taea te tirotiro te hua katoa
raffle.fair3Body: Ko te whakaahua, te tau whakawhitiwhiti, me te urunga toa ka whakaputaina hei huinga kotahi. Ko te whakahaere anō i te tatauranga mai i ngā raraunga tūmatanui me tae ki te toa kotahi.
raffle.neverPayTitle: Kare rawa a DeHub e tono kia utua e koe kia tukuna he taonga
raffle.neverPayBody: Ka whakaingoatia ngā toa i roto i te taupānga, i te whakairinga hua tūmatanui. Karekau he tangata o DeHub e whakapā atu ki a koe mō tētahi utu, he kupuhipa, he kī motuhake, he hainatanga putea rānei hei tuku i tētahi taonga. Ko ngā karere katoa pērā he tangata tinihanga. Tukua mai kia ripoata, ka murua.
raffle.faqBody: Ko ngā mea e tino pātai ana mātou mō ngā rereretanga, ngā urunga me ngā taonga.
raffle.faq1Q: Me hoko ahau i tētahi mea kia uru atu ki tētahi rereretanga taonga a DeHub?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: Kāore. Kei ia whakawhiwhinga te iti rawa o tētahi ara whakauru kore utu, ka whiwhi mā te whai wāhi ki DeHub. Ko ētahi atu whakawhiwhinga ka hokona he tiikiti i utua ki ngā tohu DeHub, engari kāore he tiikiti te ara anake hei whakauru.
raffle.faq2Q: Kei pēhea taku mōhio kāore i whakatikaina te rereretanga?
raffle.faq2A: Ka tangohia te rārangi urunga, ka whakaputaina i mua i te whakahaere i te rereretanga, ā, ko te tauwāhi toa ka tangohia mai i tētahi pūtake matapōkere i runga i te mekameka. Ko te whakaahua, te whakawhitiwhiti, me te urunga toa ka whakaputaina tahi kia taea ai e te tangata te tatauranga anō i te hua.
raffle.faq3Q: Kei pēhea te whakamōhiotia o ngā toa?
raffle.faq3A: Ka whakamōhiotia ngā toa i roto i te taupānga, ka whakaingoatia ki te whakairinga hua. Karekau he īmēra e tono utu, he kupuhipa, he hainatanga putea rānei. Kare rawa a DeHub e tono i tētahi o ēnei kia tukuna he taonga.
raffle.faq4Q: Kia hia te roa o taku kerēme?
raffle.faq4A: Tekau mā whā ngā rā mai i te whakaputanga o te hua. Ko ngā taonga tohu ka whakatau ki te putea DeHub a te toa i runga i te Pāhekoheko. Ko ngā taonga tinana ka whakaritea tika ki te kapa, ā, ka hipokina te tuku kaipuke ki te wāhi e taea ai e mātou te tuku ture.
raffle.faq5A: Ko te tangata e whai ana i te pūkete DeHub e neke atu i te 18 tau te pakeke, e noho ana i tetahi wahi he ture te hopu. Kaore nga kaimahi o DeHub, nga kirimana me o raatau whare e tika ana, a, kaore e taea te tango i nga tono i te wa e aukati ana te ture a rohe i a raatau.
raffle.faq6Q: Kia pehea te maha o nga wa e rere ana nga taraiwa?
raffle.faq6A: Kaore he mahere kua whakaritea. Ko nga whakaahua e herea ana ki nga whakarewatanga, nga tohu me nga kaupapa hoa, a ka whakapuakina ia tangata i roto i te taupānga ka whakatuwherahia.
raffle.ctaTitle: Ko nga whakaahua e rere ana i roto i te DeHub
raffle.ctaBody: Ko nga mea katoa e ora ana inaianei e whakapuakina ana i roto i to koutou kai. Whakatuwherahia nga panui kia kore ai e haere te tangata e whai ake nei ki a koe.
raffle.legal: Ko nga utu utu he whakatairanga, he tuwhera hoki ki nga kaipupuri kaute DeHub 18 tau neke atu ranei, kaore he waahi e aukati ana i te ture a rohe. Kaore nga kaimahi DeHub, nga kirimana me o raatau kaainga e tika ana. Kaore e taea te whakawhiti i nga utu mo te moni ki te kore e whakahuatia, a, ko te panui a ia draw ake e mau ana i ona tikanga katoa.

screens.glossarySubtitle: Akohia te tikanga o ia tohu me ia āhuatanga
screens.glossaryMintTxDesc: Pātōtia te tohu mōhiohio i tētahi pānui kua mintia hei whakatuwhera i tōna tauwhitinga mint i te kaitūhura paraka, ā, hei manatoko i te rekoata i runga i te mekameka. Ko te whārangi Mōhiohio Pānui katoa — tatauranga, kaipupuri, mākete — kei te taupānga tukutuku i dehub.io.
screens.glossaryTokenIdDesc: He tautohu ahurei i runga i te mekameka ka tukuna ki tētahi pānui ina mintia hei NFT.
screens.glossaryTipDesc: Tukua ngā tohu DeHub tika ki tētahi kaihanga ihirangi hei utu mō tō rātou ihirangi. Ka tuhia ngā tohutohu ki runga i te mekameka.
screens.glossaryPpvDesc: Ihirangi moni e hiahiatia ana he utu ki ngā tohu DeHub hei whakatuwhera. Ka whakatauhia e ngā kaihanga te utu, ā, ka whiwhi moni mai i ia tirohanga.
screens.glossaryWalletDesc: Tō pūkete i runga i te mekameka e pupuri ana i ō tohu DeHub me ētahi atu rawa crypto. Ka honoa mā te Web3Auth kia ngāwari te uru atu.
screens.glossaryStakingDesc: Raka ō tohu DeHub kia whiwhi utu i te wā. Ka nui ake hoki te mana pooti o ngā tohu kua raka ki te whakahaere.
screens.glossaryGovernanceDesc: Tukua me te pooti i ngā tono e whakatau ana i te papa. Ka whakatauhia tō mana pooti e te maha o ngā tohu DeHub kei a koe.
screens.glossaryStakingBadgesDesc: Ngā tohu e whakaatuhia ana i te taha o tō ingoa kaiwhakamahi i runga i te tapeke o ō pupuranga tohu DeHub (pūkete + raka). E 13 ngā taumata — ka nui ake ngā tohu kei a koe, ka teitei ake tō taumata tohu. Ka nui ake te mana pooti whakahaere me te iti ake o ngā utu papa e ngā taumata teitei.
screens.glossaryLeaderboardDesc: Ka whakataungia ngā kaiwhakamahi mā te tapeke o te pauna tohu DeHub (pūkete + raka puta noa i ngā mekameka katoa). Ka whakahoutia ngā whakataunga i ngā wā katoa, ā, ka whai i ngā huringa 1-ra me te 1-wiki. Ka taea hoki e koe te tohu mā te tohutohu i tukua, tohutohu i riro mai, ngā kaiwhai, ngā pai, me ngā kaiohauru.
screens.glossaryDhbTokenDesc: Ko te DHB te tohu ticker mo nga tohu DeHub, te tohu painga taketake o DeHub. Whakamahia mo te tipping, te ihirangi utu-ki-te-rangi, te pooti whakahaere, me te staking.

feedback.title: Urupare
feedback.intro: Kua whakamahi koe i a DeHub mo te whakatupuranga? Kōrerotia mai ki a mātou he aha te ahuatanga. He pai, he kino, he mea motuhake rānei — ka pānuitia e mātou te katoa. Mēnā kua pai ki a koe kia whakatupuranga mātou i ō kupu, tīkina te pouaka a mātou ka whakamahia pea i roto i ngā pōst, ngā ataata, i te paetukutuku rānei.
feedback.timeUsingPlaceholder: E hia nei te wā koe i konei? (he mea waatea)
feedback.consentPromo: Ka whakaaetia e au a DeHub kia whakatupuranga i tēnei urupare i roto i ngā rauemi whakamarketinga me te whakapāho.
feedback.consentName: Ka taea e koe te whakaatu i tōku ingoa-kaiwhakamahi tahi ki a ia. Waiho i te tīkina kia whakatupurangahia koe i te anonimiti.
feedback.thanks: Kua tae mai — ngā mihi. Ko ngā mea i whakaae koe mo te whakamahi whakapāho ka arotakea e te tangata i mua i te puta ki te wāhi.
feedback.toastSent: Ngā mihi — kei a mātou tō urupare

solana.unavailableTitle: Kāore e wātea te pūkoro Solana
solana.unavailableBody: Kāore tēnei pūrere e pupuri i te kī mō tō pūkoro DeHub. Takiuru anō ki te whakaora, ā, ka hoki mai tō pūkoro Solana me ia.
solana.explorerFailed: Kāore i taea te whakatuwhera i a Solscan
solana.fundingBody: Ko ngā pou, ngā koha me ngā whakatuwheratanga i runga i a Solana ka utua mai i tēnei wāhitau. Tukua he SOL ki reira mai i tētahi whakawhitinga, i tētahi pūkoro rānei — tata ki te 0.01 SOL mō ētahi pou maha. Ka ahu mai i tō pūkoro DeHub, nō reira ka hoki mai i runga i tētahi pūrere ka takiuru koe.
solana.mintingOff: Kua whakawetohia te pou ki Solana i te tūmau i tēnei wā. Kāore tō pūkoro me tō toenga e pāngia.
solana.legacyBody: I hangaia e tētahi putanga o mua o te taupānga tētahi pūkoro Solana motuhake i noho anake ki tēnei pūrere. He toenga anō kei roto. Nekehia ngā pūtea ki te wāhitau kei runga i a koe anō tēnei waea — kāore taua kī e taea te whakaora i wāhi kē.
solana.legacyViewA11y: Tirohia te pūkoro tawhito i Solscan

walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Kāore he kīanga, kāore he kī? Nō reira ka taea anake te whakatuwhera i tēnei pūkoro mai i te pūrere i hanga ai — kāore he mea i te paetukutuku, i tō mātou taha rānei e taea te whakaora. Takiuru i runga i taua pūrere mēnā kei a koe tonu.

walletSetup.protectWallet: Kia mōhio ko koe anake ka taea te pou, te whakawhitiwhiti rānei mā tēnei pūkete, tiakina tō pūkoro mā ngā koiora o tō pūrere, mā tētahi kupuhipa rānei.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: Mēnā kua whakamahi koe i dehub.io i mua, whakatuwherahia i tō rorohiko, takiuru mā te huarahi ōrite me te pūkete ōrite, ā
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: Wetewetehia mā tō maturikura, mā tō kanohi rānei — kāore he mea hei patopato, hei maumahara rānei. Ka noho te kī ki tēnei waea, nō reira ka whakaatu mātou i tētahi kīanga whakaora 12-kupu hei tuhi māu; koia anake te huarahi hoki mai i tētahi atu waea, i te paetukutuku, i muri rānei i te tāuta anō. Kōwhiria kētia te Kupuhipa, ā, mā te kupuhipa anō taua mahi.
walletSetup.biometricExplainerSecuring: Wetewetehia mā tō maturikura, mā tō kanohi rānei — kāore he mea hei patopato, hei maumahara rānei. Ka noho te kī ki tēnei waea. Kia hoki mai ai i tētahi atu waea, i te paetukutuku, i muri rānei i te tāuta anō, tiakina he taurua 12-kupu ā muri ake i ngā Tautuhinga. Kōwhiria kētia te Kupuhipa, ā, mā te kupuhipa anō taua mahi.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Kei te tiakina tēnei pūkoro e ngā koiora o tēnei pūrere. Whakaūngia mā te maturikura, mā te kanohi rānei kia haere tonu.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Whakaurua te kīanga whakaora 12-kupu i tiakina e koe i tō hanganga i tēnei pūkoro (te kī mātāmuri rānei, mēnā i kaweake koe). Ka hoki ki te pūkete ōrite, ā, ko te kupuhipa ka tautuhia e koe i raro ka noho hei taapiri e mahi ana i ngā wāhi katoa mai i tēnei wā.

walletSetup.neverUsedDehub: Kāore anō ahau kia whakamahi i dehub.io — tīmata anō

walletSetup.legacyRecovered: Kua whakaūngia tō pūkete tawhito{{suffix}}, kua whakaorangia tōna pūkoro. Whakaritea he kupuhipa hei tiaki i a ia i tēnei pūrere — i tēnei waea me ngā wāhi katoa, mai i tēnei wā.

walletSetup.startOverTitle: Tīmata anō me tētahi putea hou
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Kei tēnei pūkete he rekoata whakaora mai i te dehub.io. Ko te waehere whakaora 24-kupu i homai ki a koe ka whakatuwhera tonu i tēnei putea. Whakatuwheratia te dehub.io i runga i te rorohiko, takiuru i te ara ano, me te pūkete ano, ka whakamahi i taua waehere — ka whakahokia mai te putea, me tō pūkete, kia rite tonu ki tōna ahua o mua.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Kei tēnei pūkete he iritianga kupuhipa kua rēhitatia ki te dehub.io. I roto i te pūtirotiro e mau ana, ka taea tonu e te dehub.io te whakatuwhera i tēnei putea.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Kei tēnei pūkete neke atu i te kotahi iritianga kupuhipa kua rēhitatia ki te dehub.io. I roto i te pūtirotiro e mau ana i tetahi o aua mea, ka taea tonu e te dehub.io te whakatuwhera i tēnei putea.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: Kāore i taea te tirotiro mena kei a koe etahi atu huarahi ki te hoki mai ki tēnei putea. Ki te mea kua whirihorahia e koe he waehere whakaora, he iritianga kupuhipa rānei ki te dehub.io, haere ka ngana ki tēnā i te tuatahi — ko te haere tonu i konei ka whakakore i aua mea.
walletSetup.loseFundsHead: Nga mea katoa e mau ana i te putea tawhito.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: Ka noho tonu a ratou pauna ki {{address}}i runga i te poraka — kāore he mea i whakapaua, i tangohia rānei — engari ko te neke i aua mea ka hiahiatia te rerenga whakaora, te kī motuhake rānei o taua putea. Ki te kore tetahi, kāore e taea e te tangata te toro atu ki a ratou: ehara koe, ehara mātou. Engari ki te taea e koe te tiki i te kī mai i te taputapu nāna i hanga, whakaarohia ko nga mea kei roto kua ngaro.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Ka whakakorea te rekoata whakaora i te dehub.io hei waahanga o tēnei, no reira ka kati hoki taua ara.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: Ki te mea kua whirihorahia e koe he waehere whakaora 24-kupu ki te dehub.io, ka whakakorengia hei waahanga o tēnei. Kāore i taea e mātou te tirotiro mena kei a koe tetahi.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Ka tangohia ngā kupuhipa kua rēhitatia ki te dehub.io hei waahanga o tēnei.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Ka tangohia ngā kupuhipa kua rēhitatia ki te dehub.io hei waahanga o tēnei. Kāore i taea e mātou te tirotiro mena kei a koe tetahi.
walletSetup.keepAccountHead: Tō pūkete, kia rite tonu ki tōna ahua.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Ko te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te kōtaha, ngā whakairinga, ngā kōrero, ngā kaiwhai, ngā tohu me te hitori ka nuku katoa ki te putea hou. He pūkete tonu tēnei — kāore he tangata e rapu anō i a koe.
walletSetup.keepMessagesHead: Ngā karere me tō pouaka karere.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Ko ngā kōrero, ngā whakamōhiotanga, ngā tohu-ki-roto, ngā whakairinga kua tiakina me te hitori matakitaki ka haere tahi mai ki a koe. Kāore he mea i mukua, ā, kāore he tangata kē e taea te pānui i tetahi o aua mea.
walletSetup.keepSignInHead: Me pēhea koe e takiuru ai.
walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Tau waea, īmēra, pūkete Google rānei, kotahi tonu te pēhi. Ko te putea kei muri i te takiurunga e whakakapihia ana, ehara ko te takiurunga.
walletSetup.checkDeviceHead: Tirohia te taputapu nāna i whirihora.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Ka mau te waea ki tana kape ake o te kī i te wa e whakauruhia ana a DeHub, ka mau te pūtirotiro ki tana kupuhipa. Ki te mea kei a koe tonu tetahi o aua mea, haere ki reira, kaweake te kī motuhake, ka hoki mai ka whakamahi i te Whakaora — ka mau tonu hoki ngā pauna.
walletSetup.passwordBreached: Kua puta tēnei kupuhipa i roto i te pakarutanga raraunga — kōwhiria tētahi kē
walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: Kāore tēnei e rite ana ki te rerenga whakaora — 12 kupu, i te raupapa i whakaaturia ai, katoa he iti-kāpeke.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Ko te kī motuhake he 64 ngā pūāhua hex i muri i te 0x.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Kei tēnei pūkete he wāhitau putea kei te kona, engari kāore he tārua ka taea e tēnei waea te whakamahi — kua tiakina rānei ki te biometrics, ki te kupuhipa rānei i te paetukutuku (ka noho taua iritianga ki te pūtirotiro, kāore e tukutahi ki konei), i te mea rānei kua timata te takiuru o mua i runga i tēnei waea engari kāore i oti.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: Ki te mea kua whakamahi koe i te dehub.io i mua, whakatuwheratia i runga i tō rorohiko, takiuru i te ara ano, me te pūkete ano, ka tāpiri he kupuhipa putea — ka tiakina e tēnā he tārua kua whakakōparetia ki te kapua. Na ka hoki mai ki konei ka ngana anō.
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Ki te kore tonu e angitu, whakamahia tō kupuhipo pēke i raro nei, tērā rānei ko te "Whakauru pēke o waho".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Ka whakatuwheratia tēnei pēke mā te matimati, kanohi rānei kei tētahi pūrere motuhake — te waea, te pūtiroti rānei i whakamahia ai. Kāore tēnei waea e mau ana i taua kī, ā, kāore hoki a dehub.io: kāore rawa te kī e wehe atu i te pūrere nāna i hanga.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: I tiakina tēnei pēke mā te kī-arohanga i runga i te paetukutuku, ā, kāore anō kia whai tārua kupuhipo i roto i te kapua. Ki te whakatika koe i tētahi kupuhipo pēke i runga i te dehub.io, whakaurua ki konei — ki te kore, whakamahia te Whakauru pēke o waho i raro nei.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Kua whai pēke kē tēnei pūkete, ā, kei te tiakina e te kupuhipo. Whakaurua kia ora ai tō pēke i runga i tēnei pūrere.
walletSetup.deviceExplainer: Kaore he mea hei tuhi, hei mahara ranei — ko te kī e noho ana i runga i tenei taputapu. Ka tukuna atu e matou ki a koe he taapiri 12 kupu hei tuhi; koinei anake te huarahi ki te hoki mai i tetahi atu taputapu, mai i te paetukutuku, i muri ranei i te whakauru ano. Kōwhiria te kupuhipa hei utu, a ka mahi te kupuhipa i taua mahi.
walletSetup.deviceExplainerSecuring: Kāore he mea hei patopato, hei maumahara rānei — ka noho te kī ki tēnei pūrere. Kia hoki mai ai i tētahi atu pūrere, i te paetukutuku, i muri rānei i te tāuta anō, tiakina he taurua 12-kupu ā muri ake i ngā Tautuhinga. Kōwhiria kētia te Kupuhipa, ā, mā te kupuhipa anō taua mahi.
walletSetup.secureOnDevice: Kia mau ki te kī i runga i tenei pūrere

profile.body: Kōwhiria he ingoa ka tautōhona e te tangata, ā, tāpirihia he whakaahua pūkete, kia puta ai ō whakairinga mai i a koe.

wallet.title: Tirohia to putea me nga tohu DeHub kei reira
wallet.body: Kua noho kē to putea, kei roto hoki o tohu DeHub. Tirohia he aha kei roto, mai hea hoki.

feed.title: Kōwhiria te mea e hiahia ana koe kia kitea
feed.body: Whakautua ētahi pātai tere, ā, ka tīmata te whakaatu a tō pātaka i ngā momo whakairinga e hiahia ana koe.

first-post.title: Hangaia tō whakairinga tuatahi
first-post.body: Tāpirihia he whakaaro, he whakaahua, he ataata rānei. He wā poto noa iho, ā, mā reira koe e kitea ai e te tangata.

follow.title: Ahiwhi ētahi kaihanga tokotoru
follow.body: Ka tino pai ake tō pātaka i te wa e aru ana koe i ētahi tangata. Tirohia te hunga kei konei, ā, kōwhiria tokotoru hei tīmatanga.

comment.title: Tuhia he kōrero ki tētahi whakairinga
comment.body: Whakautu ki tetahi mea e pai ana ki a koe i runga i to kai. Ko nga korerorero te wahi e tupu ana te nuinga o DeHub.

rewards.title: Tirohia me pehea te mahi o te moni whiwhi
rewards.body: Tirohia me pehea te huri i nga tohutohu, nga tohu me nga SuperPowers i nga mea e mahi ana koe i konei ki tetahi mea e whiwhi ana koe.

language.title: Kōwhiria tō reo

commonGround.title: Te Wāhi Tūhono
commonGround.sheetHint: He okiokinga poto i mua i tō whakautu. Ka noho tūmataiti ō whakautu.
commonGround.toggleHint: I mua i tā rātou whakautu tuatahi, ka pātaia ngā kaipānui mō te pūtake kaha o tērā taha me ngā mea e hono ana rāua, ā, ka whakamaharatia kia kaua e whakaaro ki te "tetahi, ki te rānei".
commonGround.banner: Kua whakakāhia e tēnei kaihanga te arānga Tūhono. I mua i tō whakautu ka pātaia koe mō te pūtake kaha o tērā taha me ngā mea e hono ana kōrua.
commonGround.step1Title: I roto i te rerenga kotahi, he aha te pūtake kaha o tērā taha?
commonGround.step1Placeholder: Ko te pai rawa atu ka taea e rātou ko te…
commonGround.step2Title: He aha ngā mea e whakaae ana kōrua ko rātou?
commonGround.step2Placeholder: E hiahia ana māua ko rātou kia…
commonGround.reminderTitle: Kia tūpato ki te whakaaro "tetahi, ki te rānei"
commonGround.reminderBody: Ko te nuinga o ngā rerekētanga kāore he kōwhiringa i waenganui i ngā pito e rua. A, ka puta te pātai me te mea he "tetahi, ki te rānei", he maha tonu te kōwhiringa tuatoru kei waenganui.
commonGround.example1: Ka taea e tētahi hoa tata e hiahia ana kia ata noho te tiriti me tētahi hoa tata e hiahia ana kia nui ake te wāhi waka kia tika ngā hiahia.
commonGround.example2: Ka taea e ngā mātua te rerekē te whakaaro mō te wā mata me te whakaae tonu kia pai te moe o te tamaiti, kia pai hoki āna mahi ki te kura.
commonGround.noShouting: Kāore e taea te whakatau i ngā take uaua mā te hamama, mā te whakawehi rānei. Ko te whakautu marino, whai kiko te mea ka pānuitia e te tangata.

charts.areaModeHint: E whakaatu ana ngā wāhi ātaahua me ngā wāhi ōrite i ia raupapa hei rōpū. Ko te Streamgraphs te pokapū o te katoa e pā ana ki te kore, me te huna i te whāinga tohutoro. E hiahia ana ēnei rārangi ki ngā uara pūtake kore-nui. Ko te whakaaturanga tohatoha e pupuri ana i nga tatau taketake i roto i nga raraunga; ka taea e nga rohe whakarāpopototanga te whakauru i nga uara kino.
charts.benchmarkHint: Whakauruhia he whaainga tuuturu mai i nga uara puna katoa o naianei. Whakamahia te raina whaainga hei whakamahi; whakahoutia i muri i te whakatika i nga raraunga.
charts.binCounts: Kawea atu ngā tatau pini hītōkiri
charts.brandPaletteHint: Ka utaina he paetae kua tiakina ki tēnei tauira tūtohi. Ka tiakina e te paetae tiaki kia tekau ngā tae tūtohi rerekē i roto i ngā kāhua Waitohu. Ka noho kōtahi ngā uara tūtohi.
charts.brandPalettes: Ngā paetae tiaki me ngā tae tūtohi
charts.bubbleColumnHint: Ka noho ngā whakaritenga X ki te pou tuatahi. Ko te pou Y kua tīpakohia anake e pā ana ki te tauine poutū. Me whai uara kore-kino te pou rahi me te iti rawa o te kotahi uara pai; ka whakamahi te rahi ōrite i ngā taumaha wae. Mā te whakarite anō i ngā pou e pupuri ēnei tūranga me ā rātou raraunga.
charts.bubbleExample: Whakakapia te tauira ki te tauira mirumiru
charts.bubbleHint: Whakamahia ngā whakaritenga X tau i te pou tuatahi. I te aratau raupapa-maha, tīpakohia ngā pou Y me te rahi i raro nei; ka whakamahi ngā taunoa i te raupapa tuatahi mō te Y me te tuarua mō te rahi. He ōrite ngā horahanga ki te rahi; ka huna ngā rahi kore. Ki te kore he raupapa rahi, he ōrite ngā mirumiru. Ka noho ngā raupapa tāpiri ki te raraunga pūtake. E whakaatu ana ngā tapanga uara i te Y / rahi. Ka taea e ngā tuaka me te tauine te whakamahi i ngā rā me ngā wā UTC mō te X.
charts.bubbleSingleColumn: Whakahohea ngā raupapa raraunga maha hei tīpako i ngā pou Y me te rahi motuhake. Ka whakamahi te raraunga raupapa-kotahi i ngā rahi mirumiru ōrite.
charts.categoryAxisHint: Puritia ia ira raraunga i a koe e mokowā ana i ōna tapanga. Ka noho tapanga ngā kāwai tuatahi me te whakamutunga. Ka whakamahi ngā tapanga koki i te rārangi kotahi; hoki ki te 0° hei whakamahi i te takai.
charts.categoryCase: Whakatauritea te take kāwai kia tika

charts.dateAxisHint: Whakamahia ngā rā ISO (2026-01-31) me ngā tohu wā UTC (2026-01-31T14:30Z) i te pou raraunga tuatahi. E whakaatu ana ngā tūranga i te wā kua hipa, tae atu ki ngā āputa. Ka whakamahi ngā tapanga rā me te wā i te UTC i runga i ia pūrere. Ka whakawhānui ngā rohe i te tauine i a koe e pupuri ana i ngā raraunga katoa kia kitea.

Ka warewaretia ngā tātari raupapa-ingoa mēnā ka tangohia, ka whakaingoatia rānei taua raupapa. Ka pupuri ngā whakairoiro ahunga whakamua i tō rātou uara pūtake tuatahi.

Ka huri ngā rārangi tae atu ki te 50 hei ara hōieraki kua wehea e te takirirua. Me whakakī ngā pūtau kāwai, ā, kāore e taea te whai /. Mā tēnei e whakakapi te raraunga tauira ki te raupapa kotahi.

getting-started.title: Te Timata
getting-started.intro: E rima ngā ara ki DeHub, ā, kāore he mea e hiahiatia ana kia whai putea koe: Google, Apple, he waehere i tukuna ki to imeera, he waehere i tukuna mā te SMS, he putea rānei kei a koe ka honoa e koe. Ko ngā mea katoa engari ko te ara putea ka hanga he putea kore-tiaki māu i muri — kei a koe ngā kī, ā, ka tautoko a DeHub i te hau kia taea ai e koe te tuku panui, te tohutohu, me te kohikohi me te kore e hoko tohu taketake.

steps.1: Tirohia te dehub.io — ko te whāngai kāinga te whārangi mua, kia taea ai e koe te titiro huri i mua i te hainatanga.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te 'Haina'. Ka kite koe i a Google me Apple, ngā wāhi mō tētahi wahitau imeera, tau waea rānei, me te 'Hono Putea' mō tētahi kei a koe.
steps.3: Ki a Google, Apple rānei, whakaoti te rere o te kaiwhakarato. Ki te imeera, SMS rānei, tomo te waehere ka tae mai.
steps.4: Ka hangaia he putea, ka tiakina māu i te hainatanga tuatahi. Ko te hono i to ake putea ka hiahia kia kotahi te hainatanga hei whakaatu i te wāhitau.
steps.5: Kōwhiria he ingoa kaiwhakamahi. Ko te mea ka kitea e ngā tangata, ā, ka rua hei hononga ki to kōtaha dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Kua uru koe. Tirohia te whāngai, whakaritea to kōtaha, ka timata te tuku panui.

tips.1: Ko ngā hainatanga pāpori, imeera, SMS rānei kāore e utu hau — ka tautoko a DeHub. Ko ngā putea honoa ka utu i ta rātou ake ETH, BNB rānei.
tips.2: Kei te hoki mai ki tētahi kaute DeHub tawhito? Haina mā te imeera, tau waea rānei i whakamahia e ia, ā, ka kitea e te hekenga.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te pupuri i ngā kaute maha i runga i tētahi pūrere, ka huri i waenganui i a rātou i roto i ngā Tautuhinga → Kōtaha.

home-feed.title: Whāngai Kāinga
home-feed.intro: Ko te whāngai kāinga te wāhi ka kite koe i ngā panui mai i ngā tangata e whai ana koe me ngā ihirangi rongonui. Ka tautoko i ngā ripa momo ihirangi maha me ngā kōwhiringa tātari.

steps.1: Neke ki te /app — koinei to whāngai kāinga.
steps.2: Whakamahia ngā ripa o runga hei tātari mā te momo ihirangi: Kāinga (katoa), Ataata, Ngā Whakaahua, Ngā Pāpāho Poto, Waiata, me ngā Rere Ora.
steps.3: Panuku mauī/matau ki ngā ripa kia kitea ai ētahi atu kōwhiringa ki te pūkoro.
steps.4: Whakamahia te pātene tātari/taurangi (tōpito-matau o te pātaka) hei whakarerekē i te tūnga: Wera, Hou, me te Tōpito.
steps.5: Tōia kia whakahōhouhia te pātaka ki te pūkoro.
steps.6: Panuku ki raro kia utaina atu ai ngā whakairinga mā te aunoa (panuku mutunga kore).
steps.7: Hurihia i waenga i te Tirohanga Matiti me te Tirohanga Pātaka mā te whakamahi i te whakawhiti āhuahanga.

tips.1: He pai te Tirohanga Matiti mō te tirotiro tere i ngā whakaahua.
tips.2: Ko te ripa 'Kāinga' e whakaatu ana i ngā momo ihirangi katoa kua whakaranua.
tips.3: Ko te ripa Ora e whakaatu ana i ngā rerenga ora e kaha ana i tēnei wā.

creating-posts.title: Te Waihanga Whakairinga
creating-posts.intro: Waihangahia ngā whakairinga kuputuhi, tohaina ngā whakaahua, ataata, reo-rongo, GIF, me ētahi atu. Whakamahia ngā hashtags, cashtags, me ngā whakahuatanga hei whakanui i te toronga.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te pātene 'Whakairinga' i te taha taha (desktop) me te pātene + (pūkoro).
steps.2: Pāhia tō kuputuhi ki te wāhi tuhituhi.
steps.3: Hei tāpiri i tētahi whakaahua, ataata rānei, pāwhiritia te ata pāpāho ka kōwhiri i tētahi konae.
steps.4: Hei tuhi i tētahi reo-rongo, pāwhiritia te ata hopuoro.
steps.5: Hei tāpiri i tētahi GIF, pāwhiritia te ata GIF ka rapu i tētahi.
steps.6: Whakamahia ngā #hashtags hei whakarōpū i tō whakairinga (hei tauira, #crypto, #defi).
steps.7: Whakamahia ngā $cashtags hei tohutoro i ngā tohu (hei tauira, $DHB, $ETH).
steps.8: Whakamahia ngā @mentions hei tohu i ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi (hei tauira, @username).
steps.9: Pāwhiritia te 'Whakairinga' hei whakaputa. Ka puta tō whakairinga ki te pātaka tonu.

tips.1: Ka tautoko ngā whakairinga i te whakatakanga momo markdown.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te whakairinga-kōrero mā te pāwhiri i te ata repost i runga i tētahi whakairinga ka kōwhiri i te 'Kōrero'.
tips.3: Ka puta ngā kāwai (hashtags) ki te papa whakataetae 'Kōrero o te Taone'.

interacting-with-posts.title: Te Whakawhitiwhiti ki ngā Whakairinga
interacting-with-posts.intro: Whakawhitiwhiti ki te ihirangi mā te pōti, te kōrero, te tohutohu, te tiaki pukapuka, te tohutohu, me te whakamaori.

steps.1: Pōtitia whakarunga, whakararo rānei tētahi whakairinga mā te whakamahi i ngā ata pere kei te taha mauī o tētahi whakairinga.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te ata kōrero hei whakatuwhera i te wāhanga kōrero ka waiho he whakautu.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia te ata kohatu/tohunga hei tuku i tētahi tohunga ki ngā tohu DeHub ki te kaihanga whakairinga.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia te ata tiaki pukapuka hei whakaora i tētahi whakairinga mō muri mai.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te ata tohutohu hei kōkopi i te hono whakairinga me te tohutohu ki waho.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia te paatene whakamaori (tohu ao) i runga i tetahi pou hei whakamaori i te tuhingi ki to reo.
steps.7: Mo nga pou whakaahua, whakamahia te paatene 'Whakamaori Whakaahua' kia whiwhi ai koe i te putanga kua whakamaoritia e te AI o te tuhingi kei roto i te ahua.
steps.8: Pāwhiritia tetahi pou hei whakatuwhera i roto i te tirohanga pou kotahi mata-katoa.

tips.1: Ko nga tohutohu ka haere tika ki te putea a te kaihanga i roto i nga tohu DeHub.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i te nui o te tohutohu ma te paatene tere-kōwhiri, ka uru ranei ki tetahi nui ritenga.
tips.3: Ko nga pou kua tohua ka uru atu mai i te wharangi Tohu i te taha taha.

explore-search.title: Tirotiro me te Rapu
explore-search.intro: Tirohia nga ihirangi me nga kaiwhakamahi hou na roto i te wharangi tirotiro me te kaha rapu.

steps.1: Haere ki te /app/explore mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Whakamahia te pae rapu kei runga hei rapu kaiwhakamahi, pou, me nga ihirangi.
steps.3: Tātarihia nga hua ma te ripa: Katoa, Tangata, Pou, Whakaahua, Ataata, Waiata, Ora.
steps.4: Tirotiro nga kaupapa rongonui me nga waahanga kei te wharangi tirotiro.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia tetahi kaupapa rongonui kia kite i nga pou katoa e pa ana.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tetahi kaiwhakamahi i roto i nga hua rapu kia toro atu ki ta raatau korero.

tips.1: Ko te rapu e tautoko ana i nga ingoa kaiwhakamahi, nga wahitau putea, me nga kupu matua ihirangi.
tips.2: Ka whakahouhia nga kaupapa rongonui i runga i nga mahi whakaputa tata nei.

profile.title: Kōtaha
profile.intro: Ko to korero e whakaatu ana i o pou, kaiwhai, whai, me nga korero putea.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia to avatar, 'Kōtaha' ranei i te taha taha kia kite i to korero.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia 'Whakatika Kōtaha' hei whakahou i to ingoa whakaatu, bio, me to avatar.
steps.3: Tukuna he pikitia korero ma te paatene i to avatar i te aratau whakatika.
steps.4: Tirohia o tatauranga kaiwhai me te whai i runga i to wharangi korero.
steps.5: Tirotiro i o ake pou, pāpāho, me nga ihirangi i pai ki a koe na roto i nga ripa korero.
steps.6: Kopirihia to wahitau putea ma te paatene i te tohu kape i muri i a ia.
steps.7: Toro atu ki nga korero a etahi atu kaiwhakamahi ma te paatene i o raatau ingoa kaiwhakamahi, avatar ranei i nga waahi katoa o te papaa.

tips.1: He ahurei to ingoa kaiwhakamahi, ka puta ki to URL korero (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Ma nga tautuhinga tūmataiti ka taea e koe te whakahaere ko wai ka kite i o tatauranga kaiwhai.

messages.title: Karere
messages.intro: Tukuna nga karere tika ki etahi atu kaiwhakamahi i runga i te papaa.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia 'Karere' i te taha taha hei whakatuwhera i te wharangi karere.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te paatene tuhituhi kia tīmata ai he kōrero hou.
steps.3: Rapua he kaiwhakamahi mā te ingoa kaiwhakamahi kia īmēra atu ki a ia.
steps.4: Tuhia tō karere, ka pēhi i te tuku.
steps.5: Tirohia tō hītori kōrero i roto i te rārangi karere.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tētahi kōrero kia haere tonu te korerorero.

tips.1: Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi whakamōhiotanga ka īmēra mai tētahi ki a koe.
tips.2: Ka taea e ngā kaihanga te raka ngā karere ki muri i te whakaritenga tohutohu.

ai-assistant.title: Kaiawhina AI
ai-assistant.intro: Kōrero ki te kaiawhina AI kua oti te hanga o DeHub mō te āwhina, mō ngā mōhiohio, me ngā mahi auaha.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Kaiawhina' i te taha taha kia whakatuwheratia te kōrero AI.
steps.2: Tuhia tō pātai, tō tono rānei i te whakaurunga kōrero.
steps.3: Ka taea e te AI te āwhina ki ngā mōhiohio crypto, ki ngā pātai papaa, me ngā mōhiohio whānui.
steps.4: Tīmata tētahi kōrero hou mā te pāwhiri i te paatene kōrero hou.
steps.5: Tirohia tō hītori kōrero i te taha taha o te whārangi kaiawhina.
steps.6: Ka taea e koe te whakapiri pikitia kia tātarihia e te AI.

tips.1: Ka mahara te AI ki te horopaki i roto i tētahi kōrero.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te pātai ki te AI mō ngā āhuatanga o DeHub, ngā kupu crypto, me ngā pātai whānui.
tips.3: Ka tiakina ngā kōrero o mua, ka taea te uru atu i ngā wā katoa.

notifications.title: Ngā whakamōhiotanga
notifications.intro: Kia whakahoutia ki ngā pai, ngā kōrero, ngā tohutohu, ngā whai, me ngā atu mahi i runga i tō ihirangi.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata pere, te 'Ngā whakamōhiotanga' rānei i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā whakamōhiotanga katoa i roto i tētahi rārangi wā.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia tētahi whakamōhiotanga kia neke ki te ihirangi e pā ana.
steps.4: Kei roto i ngā whakamōhiotanga: ngā kaiwhai hou, ngā pōti pou, ngā kōrero, ngā tohutohu, me ngā whakahuatanga.
steps.5: Ka tohua ngā whakamōhiotanga kāore anō kia pānuihia — ka tohua hei pānui ka tirohia.

tips.1: Ko te tohu whakamōhiotanga e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā whakamōhiotanga kāore anō kia pānuihia.
tips.2: Ko ngā whakamōhiotanga tohutohu e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā tohu i whiwhi koe.

wallet.title: Pukoro
wallet.intro: Tirohia ngā toenga tohu DeHub i runga i ngā mekameka maha, tirohia ngā tāpui whakauru, ka whakahaere i ō rawa.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Pukoro' i te taha taha kia whakatuwheratia te whārangi pukoro.
steps.2: Tirohia tō katoa o ngā tohu toenga i whakahiato ki ngā mekameka tautokona katoa.
steps.3: Tirohia ngā whakahaere mō ia mekameka: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, me ētahi atu.
steps.4: Tirohia āu putunga rahui me ngā utu.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te 'Refresh Scan' hei whakahou i āu toenga mai i ngā raraunga mekameka.
steps.6: Kōpi tō wāhitau putea ki te whiwhi tohu mai i ētahi atu.

tips.1: Ka whakahou aunoa ngā toenga engari ka taea e koe te kaha ki te whakahou i ngā wā katoa.
tips.2: E whakaatu ana te putea i ngā toenga wai (e wātea ana) me ngā toenga rahui.

staking.title: Rahui
staking.intro: Rahuia āu tohu DeHub kia whiwhi ai koe i ngā utu, kia piki ai tō mana pooti whakahaere.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Staking' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te rahui.
steps.3: Tīpakohia te mekameka e hiahia ana koe ki te rahui.
steps.4: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga i roto i tō putea (ngā putea o waho) ka whakahaerehia aunoatia (social login).
steps.5: Tirohia āu moni rahui me ngā utu tatari.
steps.6: Hei un-stake, whakauruhia te moni ka whakaūngia te tauwhitinga un-stake.

tips.1: Ka piki te rahui i tō taumaha pooti i roto i ngā tono whakahaere.
tips.2: Kāore ngā kaiwhakamahi Social-login e hiahia ana ki te hau kia rahui — he kore hau.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te rahui ki ngā mekameka maha i te wā kotahi.

leaderboard.title: Papatohu
leaderboard.intro: Tirohia ko wai kei runga! Ka whakarōrangitia e te papatohu ngā kaiwhakamahi mā te toenga, te whakapau o ia rā, me ngā kaupapa rongonui.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Leaderboard' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tohua i waenga i ngā ripa: Balance, Daily Spent, me Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Ko te ripa Balance ka whakarōrangitia ngā kaiwhakamahi mā ā rātou pupuri tohu katoa.
steps.4: Ko te ripa Daily Spent e whakaatu ana ko wai te tino kaha ki te tohu i roto i ngā haora 24 kua hipa.
steps.5: Ko te Talk of the Town e whakaatu ana i ngā kaupapa/kātene tino matapaki.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tētahi kaiwhakamahi ki te toro ki tōna kōtaha.
steps.7: Ka whakahouhia te papatohu i ngā wā puta noa i te rā.

tips.1: Ka hoki anō ngā whakarōrangitanga o ia rā ia 24 haora.
tips.2: Ko te Talk of the Town e whai ana i ngā kātene kotahi kupu mai i ngā hashtags.

command-centre.title: Pokapū Whakahau
command-centre.intro: He tirohanga papatohu e whakaatu ana i o inenga matua me te mahi papanga i te tirohanga kanohi.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Command Centre' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia to whakarāpopototanga tauira, tae atu ki te maha o ngā whakairinga, ngā kaiwhai, me te uru.
steps.3: Tirohia to mahi tata nei me ngā kaupapa rongonui.
steps.4: Uru atu ki ngā hononga tere ki ngā āhuatanga e whakamahia nuitia ana.

tips.1: Ka hoatu e te Command Centre ki a koe he tirohanga mai i te rangi o to nohoanga DeHub.

governance.title: Kāwanatanga
governance.intro: Whai wāhi ki te kāwanatanga o te papanga mā te hanga tūtohutanga me te pōti i ngā whakatau a te hapori.

steps.1: Haere ki te 'Governance' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā tūtohutanga kaha i tukuna e te hapori.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia he tūtohutanga kia pānuihia tana whakaahuatanga katoa me te whakawhitiwhiti whakaaro.
steps.4: Pōtia ngā tūtohutanga mā te whakamahi i ngā patene matimati runga/raro — ka whakawhirinaki to taumaha pōti ki te maha o ngā tohu DeHub kua whakatakotoria e koe.
steps.5: Waiho he kōrero i runga i ngā tūtohutanga kia whakawhitiwhiti whakaaro ki te hapori.
steps.6: Tukuna to ake tūtohutanga mā te pāwhiri i te patene 'Create Proposal'.

tips.1: Ka whakatauhia to mana pōti e te maha o ngā tohu kua whakatakotoria e koe.
tips.2: Ka whiwhi pea ngā kaipupuri tohu i te taumaha pōti anō.
tips.3: Ka puta ngā tūtohutanga i ngā wāhanga: Kaha → Kua Pahemo/Kua Whakakorea.

bookmarks.title: Ngā Pukapuka
bookmarks.intro: Tiakina ngā whakairinga ki o pukapuka kia ngāwari te uru atu a muri ake nei.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata pukapuka i runga i tetahi whakairinga kia tiakina.
steps.2: Haere ki te 'Bookmarks' i te taha taha kia kitea katoatia ngā whakairinga kua tiakina.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia he whakairinga kua tohua hei pukapuka kia kitea katoatia.
steps.4: Tangohia he pukapuka mā te pāwhiri anō i te ata pukapuka.

tips.1: He muna ngā pukapuka — ko koe anake ka kite i o whakairinga kua tiakina.
tips.2: Kāore he rohe ki te maha o ngā whakairinga ka taea e koe te tohua hei pukapuka.

settings.title: Tautuhinga
settings.intro: Whakaritea to wheako DeHub mā te reo, te tūmataitinga, me ngā manakohanga whakaatu.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Settings' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Hurihia to reo whakaatu mai i te kōwhiri reo.
steps.3: Whakarerekē ngā tautuhinga tūmataitinga: whakahaere ko wai ka kite i o tatauranga kaiwhai me te rarangi whai.
steps.4: Whakaritea ō tautuhinga matapōkere o ngā whakairinga.
steps.5: Whakahaerehia ngā tautuhinga whakamōhiotanga.

tips.1: Ka tautoko a DeHub i ngā reo maha — ka whakamaoritia te atanga katoa.
tips.2: Ka whai mana tonu ngā tautuhinga tūmataiti.

posting-allowance.title: Tō Āhuru Whakairinga o Ia Rā
posting-allowance.intro: He kore utu te whakairi ia rā tae noa ki tētahi rohe ka piki ake ki tō tohu takahi. Ka tīmata te katoa ki te tekau whakairinga kuputuhi me tētahi gigabyte o te ataata, ngā whakaahua me te oro ia rā. Haere ki tua atu i tētahi o ēnei, ka utua te toenga o taua rā ki ngā tohu DeHub — ko te wāhanga anake e pā ana.

steps.1: Whakairihia kia rite ki te tikanga. I roto i te rohe, kāore he utu, kāore hoki he tono ki a koe.
steps.2: He rerekē ngā puna whakairinga kuputuhi me ngā puna pāpāho, nā reira ko te rā e whakapau ana ki te tuku ataata ka waiho tonu kia tekau ngā whakairinga kuputuhi.
steps.3: Ka pā ana tētahi whakairinga ki tua atu, ka whakataua te taupānga i te tuatahi, ka tirotiro mena ka taea e tō putea te utu i mua i te tuku.
steps.4: Ka whakaputaina te whakairinga kia rite ki te mea i roto i te rohe — kāore te whakaputanga e tatari ki te utu.
steps.5: Ka whakaaetia e koe tētahi whakawhiti mo taua whakairinga anake, ka whakatauhia ki te Base, ki te BNB Chain rānei kei a ia ngā tohu DeHub.
steps.6: Ka tautetia ngā puna e rua i te waenganui pō UTC.

tips.1: Ko te nui ake he pro-rata: 200 MB i tua atu i tō rohe ka utu 200 MB, ehara i te gigabyte katoa.
tips.2: Ko ngā whakairinga anō, ngā kōrero, ngā tauhohenga, ngā tohutohu me ngā karere he kore utu, kāore hoki e pā ki te rohe.
tips.3: Whakaaetia te utu, ka noho tonu te whakairinga — ka aukati noa te nui i tō whakairinga utu e whai ake nei kia utua ra ano. Ko te rohe kore utu o āpōpō nau tonu.
tips.4: Ka piki ake te rohe kore utu o tētahi tohu takahi, ka whakaheke hoki i te utu o ngā mea i tua atu.

reactions-and-safety.title: Ngā Tauhohenga, Te Whakamutu me ngā Ihirangi Tūmatanui
reactions-and-safety.intro: E iwa ngā tauhohenga kei muri i te paatene pai, me tētahi huinga mana mo te whakatau i ngā mea ka kite koe me te hunga ka taea te whakapā atu ki a koe.

steps.1: Purihia te koromatua ki runga i tētahi whakairinga hei whakatuwhera i te paepae tauhohenga: pai, aroha, whakaute, wera, lol, pouri, tangi, kino, me te paru.
steps.2: Ko ngā whitu pai ka tatau ki te tapeke pai o te whakairinga; ko te kino me te paru ka tatau ki te taha ki raro.
steps.3: Ko tō tauhohenga ka taumaha e tō tohu takahi, nā reira ko te tauhohenga a te kaipupuri tohu ka nui ake te tatau i te kotahi pooti.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia te X i te pane o tētahi whakairinga hei whakamutu i tōna kaituhi — ka ngaro tonu ratou i tō whāngai.
steps.5: Ka tohuhia e ngā kaituhi a ratou ake whakairinga hei tūmatanui i te wa e hanga ana; ka noho tonu aua whakairinga ki waho o te whāngai kāinga.
steps.6: Hei kite i ngā whakairinga tūmatanui ki ngā wāhi katoa, whakauruhia te 'Whakaatu ihirangi tūmatanui' i roto i ngā Tautuhinga.

tips.1: He tino kitea tonu te whakairinga tūmatanui ki te pūkete a te kaituhi me te hunga e whai ana i a ratou.
tips.2: Ko te aukati mai i tētahi pūkete ka nui ake i te whakamutu, ka aukati hoki i te tuku karere.
tips.3: Ka whakaatu te paepae tauhohenga ko wai i tauhohe me te aha, nā reira ka kite koe i te ruma, kaua ko te nama anake.

stages.title: Ngā Wāhanga (Ngā Rūma Oro Ora)
stages.intro: Ko ngā Wāhanga he ruma oro ora i hangaia ki roto i a DeHub. Ka whakatuwherahia e tētahi kaihautū tētahi ruma, ka kawea ake ngā kaikorero, ā, ka taea e te tangata te tomo ki te whakarongo mai i te whārangi Wāhanga, i tētahi hononga kua tohaina rānei.

steps.1: Whakatuwherahia te 'Wāhanga' i te taha taha hei kite i ngā mea e ora ana inaianei me ngā mea kua whakaritea.
steps.2: Patia he atamira ora hei whakauru hei kaikōrero, ka whakarite rānei i tētahi whakamaharatanga ki tētahi kua whakaritea, ā, ka whakamōhiotia koe ina tīmata.
steps.3: Tīmata tō ake mai i te whārangi kotahi — ka taea e koe te haere ora tika mai i te pūtirotiro, kāore he OBS, kāore he kī kōrere.
steps.4: Hei kaihautū, kawea ngā kaikorero ki te atamira, whakawātea, whakakore rānei i a rātou, tohaina tō mata, ā, whakahaerehia te papa oro.
steps.5: Ka tukuna e ngā kaikōrero ngā tauhohe ora, ā, ka kōrero i roto i te kōrerorero ruma me te kore e tae ki te atamira.
steps.6: Ka tuhia ia atamira, ā, ka takaro anō te rekoata i muri mai i te kaari e puta ana.

tips.1: Ka tohua e ngā kupu hauraro ora ia kaikorero, ā, ka whakamaoritia ki ngā reo katoa e pānui ana koe.
tips.2: Ka taea e te reo irirangi ora te kōrero i te ruma ki te reo kōpeke o te kaihautū, ka utua ia meneti ki ngā tohu DeHub.
tips.3: Ka taea e ngā kaihautū te whakanoho i tētahi reo irirangi ki te rangi, te purei rānei i a rātou ake topenga waiata i waenga i ngā kōrero.
tips.4: Ka mau tonu te ruma ki te kaitākaro iti i te kokonga i a koe e tirotiro ana i te toenga o te taupānga.

communities.title: Ngā Hapori me ngā Takahanga
communities.intro: Ko ngā hapori he wāhi e whakahaeretia ana e ngā mema, me ā rātou ake kōrero, mema, me ngā mahi. Ka tāpiri ngā huihuinga i ngā kaupapa kua herea ki te wā ki runga ake i a rātou.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Hapori' i te taha taha, ā, tirotirohia ngā hapori tūmatanui.
steps.2: Hono atu ki tētahi pā. Ka puta ngā mahi hou hei tohu kāore anō kia pānuitia i roto i te whakatere.
steps.3: Tukuna, matapaki, whakahaere pōtitanga, ā, hoatu moni ki roto i te kōrero a te hapori.
steps.4: Ka whakahaere ngā rangatira o te hapori i ā rātou ake wāhi, ā, ka taea e rātou te tuku mana whakahaere ki ētahi atu.
steps.5: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Takahanga' mō ngā kaupapa kua whakaritea, me tētahi whārangi katoa mō ia huihuinga ka taea e koe te whai i te ora.

tips.1: Ka tautoko te kōrerorero a te hapori i ngā @whakapā me te @konei, nō reira ka taea e tētahi panui te tae ki te ruma.
tips.2: Ka taea e tētahi hononga powhiri te kawe tika i ngā tangata ki roto i tētahi hapori.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.intro: E rima ngā kēmu e rere ana i roto i te DeHub i roto i tētahi ripa pūtirotiro — kāore he mea hei whakauru, kāore he mea hei hoko.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Arcade' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Kōwhiria tētahi kēmu: King's Gambit (chess 3D me tētahi arawhata Elo ipurangi), Claude of Duty (he kaikōkiri e whakaputa ana i āna ake toi i te wa e utaina ana), Jungle Trail (he hikoi ngāherehere ngāherehere), Street Slayer (he beat 'em up i hangaia mō DeHub) rānei Chartopia (he papa hokohoko ka taea te hikoi).
steps.3: Tākaro i te ripa. Ka mau a King's Gambit me Street Slayer i ngā papa kēmu.
steps.4: Ka rere anō a Chartopia i roto i tētahi pane VR mā WebXR.

tips.1: E rua o ēnei ka huna ki roto i ngā kaupapa ahua — whakaritea te taupānga ki te War mō Claude of Duty, ki te Jungle rānei mō Jungle Trail.
tips.2: He kaari tiritiri tō ia kēmu, nō reira ka tika te whakatuwhera o tētahi hono ki a ia ki hea koe e tuku ai.

bounties-stores.title: Ngā Pūtaonga me ngā Toa
bounties-stores.intro: E rua ngā huarahi hei huri i te papaa ki te moni: tukuna, kōwhiria rānei tētahi pūtaonga, whakatuwheratia rānei tētahi toa, ā, hokona atu ki tō hunga.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Pūtaonga' hei tirotiro i ngā mahi tuwhera, kua tātarihia e te kātene, te moni rānei.
steps.2: Kōwhiria tētahi, mahia te mahi, ā, tukuna atu kia whiwhi ai i te utu — ka taea e te tangata katoa te kaikōkura, kāore he tono e hiahiatia.
steps.3: Tukua tō ake pōkai utu me tētahi kōrero poto me tētahi utu i roto i ngā tohu DeHub, USDC rānei. Ka noho ki te pūtea tiaki i te wā e tukua ana e koe.
steps.4: Whakatuwheratia te 'Toa' ki te whakarite i tētahi toa me tōna ake whārangi, tohu, me ngā rārangi.
steps.5: Ka whakatauhia ngā hua, ka utua ki ngā tohu DeHub mā te pēke i hangaia, kāore he pūnaha utu waho.

tips.1: Ka whakarōpūhia ngā pōkai utu ki roto i ngā Pāpāho Pāpori, Te Tapahi, me ngā Kirimana.
tips.2: Ka whakatauhia e tētahi pūnaha tautohetohe ngā rerekētanga mō te tuku, kia whakatauhia ai te pūtea tiaki kia tika tonu.
tips.3: Ka whakamahi ngā kaihanga i ngā pōkai utu ki te whakatipu i tētahi hapori — ko ngā hea, ngā tapahi, me ngā tauhohenga he mahi katoa.

creator-studio.title: Studio Kaihanga me te Etita
creator-studio.intro: Ka whakaputa te Studio Kaihanga i ngā whakaahua, ataata, waiata, reo, me ngā tauira 3D mai i tētahi akiaki, ā, ka tukuna ki tētahi etita — tae atu ki tētahi etita ataata maha-ara e rere ana i roto i te pūtirotiro.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te Studio Kaihanga ka whakaahuatia te mea e hiahia ana koe kia hangaia.
steps.2: Ka whakatauhia e te tūmau te utu i mua i te whakahaerenga o te mahi, kia kite koe i te utu i mua i te whakapau.
steps.3: Ka haere tonu ngā whakaahua ki roto i tētahi rarangi tūruhi i a koe e haereere ana i te taupānga.
steps.4: Whakaritea ngā hua ki roto i te etita momo Canva, ki te whakatuwhera rānei i te etita ataata mō tētahi wā tūturu me te tapahi, te whakatō, me te kaweake.
steps.5: Tukua te wāhanga kua oti ki roto tonu i tētahi pou, he poto, he rārangi toa rānei.

tips.1: He whare putunga taonga koreutu kei te taha o te Studio mō ngā mea katoa e pai ake ana koe kia kaua e whakaputa.
tips.2: Ka utua te whakaputanga ki ngā tohu DeHub mai i tō pēke — ka hainatia e koe tētahi whakawhiti mō ia mahi, ā, ka whakatauhia te utu i mua i te utu.
tips.3: Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi taumaha te tango i tētahi mahere Ultra, Team, me Scale rānei, ka tukuna he taumata tohu ā-marama ki tō rātou pēke.

buying-dhb.title: Te Hoko Tohu
buying-dhb.intro: Hokona ngā tohu DeHub tika i roto i te taupānga mā te whakamahi i te atanga whakawhiti i hangaia.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Hokona' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tīpakohia te tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te whakawhiti mai (hei tauira, ETH, USDC).
steps.3: Whakauruhia te nui e hiahia ana koe ki te whakapau, ki te maha rānei o ngā tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te whiwhi.
steps.4: Arotakehia te reiti whakawhiti me te hua kua tatauhia.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te ata taputapu tautuhinga hei whakarereke i te manawanui o te reti (ko te taunoa ko te 1%).
steps.6: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga whakawhiti.
steps.7: Ka puta ngā tohu DeHub ki tō pēke i te wā ka oti te tauwhitinga.

tips.1: Ko te manawanui o te reti teitei ake = ka nui ake te tupono ki te whakahaere, engari ka taea te utu kino ake.
tips.2: Tirohia tonu te reiti whakawhiti i mua i te whakaū.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i te reti ritenga i roto i te panui tautuhinga.

bridge.title: Pūwhiti
bridge.intro: Nekehia ngā tohu DeHub i waenga i ngā poraka tautokona mā te whakamahi i te pūwhiti poraka-a-taha.

steps.1: Whāia te whārangi 'Bridge' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tīpakohia te mekameka pūtake (ko reira tō koutou tohu kei nāianei).
steps.3: Tīpakohia te mekameka ūnga (ko reira koutou e hiahia ana kia tukuna atu).
steps.4: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā tohu hei piriti.
steps.5: Arotakehia te utu piriti me te wā taenga tatari.
steps.6: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga piriti.
steps.7: Mā te rōpū e tuku ngā tohu ki te mekameka taunga, i te nuinga o te wā i roto i ngā rā mahi 1-5.

tips.1: He rerekē ngā utu piriti mā te takirua mekameka.
tips.2: I tēnei wā, ka utua ā-ringa ngā utu piriti.
tips.3: Tirohia anō te mekameka ūnga i mua i te whakaūnga.

music-tv.title: Mūmū & Pouaka Whakaata
music-tv.intro: Kia pai ki ngā ihirangi pāpāho tika i roto i te DeHub — rerengia te waiata me te matakitaki i ngā pouaka whakaata ora.

steps.1: Whāia te 'Music' mai i te taha taha ki te rapu me te purei i ngā pou waiata.
steps.2: Whāia te 'TV' ki te uru atu ki ngā pouaka whakaata ora.
steps.3: Rapua ngā pouaka whakaata mā te kātene, mā te whenua rānei.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia tētahi pouaka whakaata ki te tīmata te matakitaki.
steps.5: Whakamahia ngā mana purei ki te whakatika i te oro me te purei anō.
steps.6: Pūrongohia ngā pouaka whakaata pakaru mā te whakamahi i te paatene pūrongo.

tips.1: Ko ngā pouaka whakaata ka whakamanahia e te hapori mō te pono.
tips.2: Ka taea te purei i ngā pou waiata i te wa e rapu ana i ētahi atu ihirangi.

post-info.title: Ngā Mōhiohio Pou & Wehenga
post-info.intro: Ko te pou i whakawhitia he NFT ka wehea ki te 1,000 wehenga. Ko te whārangi Mōhiohio Pou e whakaatu ana i ngā raraunga i runga mekameka, ngā tatauranga whakauru, te pakanga o te mana, me te tuku ki a koe ki te hokohoko i ngā wehenga o tētahi pou — i runga i tētahi pou kaore i whakawhitia ka tuku ki te whakawhiti hei utu.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata 'ⓘ' i runga i tētahi pou ki te whakatuwhera i tōna whārangi Mōhiohio Pou.
steps.2: Kei runga ka kite koe i te ID Tohu (tohu motuhake i runga mekameka) me te hash tauwhitinga — pāwhiritia te hash ki te tiro i runga i te kaitirotiro poraka.
steps.3: I raro iho i tēnā, ko ngā tatauranga whakauru e whakaatu ana i te tapeke o ngā pai, ngā kino, ngā tirohanga, ngā kōrero, me ngā tohu i whiwhia.
steps.4: Ko te wāhanga Kai-pupuri e whakaatu ana i tētahi pae-whakaeke o te maha o ngā 1,000 wehenga e pupuri tonu ana te kaihanga, me tētahi rārangi o ngā kaipupuri wehenga katoa me ō rātou toenga me ngā ōrau.
steps.5: Mēnā he utu-mō-te-titiro (PPV) te pou, ka kite koe i te utu, te moni, me te maha o ngā kaiwhakamahi kua hokona te uru.
steps.6: Ka taea e ngā kaipupuri pou te whakarerekē i te kitenga (Tūmatanui, Kaore i Rēhitatia, rānei Motuhake) me te whakatika i te taitara/whakaahuatanga tika mai i tēnei whārangi.

tips.1: Ka tīmata te pou hou i whakawhitia ki te kaihanga e pupuri ana i ngā 1,000 wehenga katoa (100% mana).
tips.2: Ko te hash tauwhitinga ka hono atu ki te BaseScan, ki te BscScan rānei i runga i te mekameka.
tips.3: Ngā pou kāore i te rārangi kaore e puta ki ngā pātaka engari ka taea tonu te toro atu mā te hononga tika.

trading-fractions.title: Nga Whakataunga Hokohoko
trading-fractions.intro: Hokohoko wahi — rārangi tirotiro, hanga tuku, whakarārangitia koutou ake — ora i runga i te taupānga tukutuku i dehub.io, i runga i ia whārangi Post Info.

steps.1: Whakatūwhera dehub.io i roto i te pūtirotiro, me te takiuru ki te pūkete kotahi.
steps.2: Whakatuwherahia te whārangi Post Info me te huri ki tona ripa Marketplace.
steps.3: Rēhita pereti, hanga i te tuku i runga i to koutou utu, ranei rārangi wahi e pupuri koe.
steps.4: Kia oti te hokohoko, ka puta te huringa i roto i to koutou ripa Fractions i konei i runga i te pūkoro.

tips.1: Ko te whai i te wahi o te pou e te tikanga e pupuri koe i te wahi o taua NFT i runga i te rīpene.
tips.2: Tirohia ngā kaipupuri pou i runga i te mākete tukutuku ki te kite i te tohatoha rangatira i mua i te hoko.
tips.3: Hei kaihanga, ko te hoko i nga waahanga ka taea e nga kaiwhaiwhai te whakakotahi i to ihirangi.

minting-posts.title: Te Whakaputa Pou (Te Hanga NFT)
minting-posts.intro: He kōwhiringa te whakaputa. Ka whakaputa te pou ki waho o te mekameka i te wā e tukuna ana e koe — karekau he putea, karekau he waitohu, karekau he hau — ā, ka taea e koe te whakaputa hei NFT i ngā wā katoa e hiahia ana koe, ahakoa i te wa e tuhi ana koe, i muri mai rānei mai i te pou ake.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te pātene 'Pou' i te taha taha (papamahi) me te pātene + (waea pūkoro).
steps.2: Tuhia tō kuputuhi, āpiti ngā pāpāho (ngā whakaahua, ngā ataata, te oro), me te tāpiri kāwai.
steps.3: Waiho te 'Whakaputa pou' kia weto kia whakaputa ki waho o te mekameka, ki te kore rānei ka huri ki te whakaputa i te wa e whakaputa ana koe.
steps.4: Kāore te whakaputa i te tatari ki te mekameka: ka puta te pou ki te whangai ahakoa pēhea.
steps.5: Hei whakaputa i muri mai, whakatuwheratia te whārangi mōhiohio 'ⓘ' o te pou ka whakamahi i te mahi Whakaputa kei reira.
steps.6: Ka oti te whakaputa, ka whiwhi te pou i te ID Tohu me te hash tauwhitinga ka taea e koe te manatoko i runga i te mekameka, ā, kei a koe ngā 1,000 wāhanga katoa o taua mea.

tips.1: Ko ngā takiuru pāpori, īmēra, me SMS kaore he utu hau – ka tautoko a DeHub i ngā utu whakaputa.
tips.2: Ko ngā kaiwhakamahi putea o waho me whai ETH i runga i te Base, i te BNB rānei i runga i te BNB Chain mō te hau.
tips.3: Ko te whakaputa te mea ka taea ai te hokohoko me te kawe paanga o te pou. Ko te pou kaore i whakaputaina ka whiwhi tonu i ngā tohu me ngā tirohanga.
tips.4: Ko te rekoata i runga i te mekameka ka mau tonu ka oti te whakaputa, ahakoa ka mukua te pou i te whangai i muri mai.

glossary.title: Kupu Whakamārama
glossary.intro: He kohinga kupu matawhānui mō te crypto me te reo o te papanga hei āwhina i a koe ki te whakatere i te Web3.

steps.1: Haere ki te 'Kupu Whakamārama' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā kupu kia whakarōpūhia, ka whakamahi rānei i te rapunga hei kimi kupu motuhake.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia tētahi kupu kia kite ai i tōna whakamārama katoa me tōna whakamaarama.
steps.4: Ko ngā kupu ka hipoki i ngā ariā crypto, te reo DeFi, me ngā āhuatanga motuhake o DeHub.

tips.1: He rauemi nui mō ngā tauhou ki te crypto me te Web3.
tips.2: Ka whakahoutia te kohinga kupu i ia wā ki ngā kupu hou.

depin.title: DePin
depin.noFixedRate: Kāore he reiti mōhio, he hua iti, he APY, he matapae anamata rānei. Ko ngā rekoata takoha he whakauru pūkete anake, ehara i te oati utu. Ko ngā whakataunga tohu a muri ake nei ka puta ki runga i te Base, ka noho tonu ki raro i te mana o te tika, ngā ture whatunga, me te ture e tika ana.

depin.ctaTitle: Whakarewa noa ka haumaru te rahunga.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Kei raro nei he pona mama, kei roto i te pūtirotiro. Ko te pona rorohiko taumaha, ka noho tonu, he aronga kei te heke mai, kāore anō kia wātea. Kāore te whakauru e taurangi i te utu.
depin.footerNote: Ko te whakauru DePin he ratonga koha, ehara i te hua whakangao. Ka taea te whakarerekē te wātea, te tika, me ngā utu.
depin.heroBlurb: Koha atu te rokiroki, te bandwidth, me te pūngao hei āwhina i te manaaki, te whakawhiti, me te tuku ihirangi DeHub.
depin.heroCaption: Kei a DeHub te kape taketake. Ka tāpiri ngā pona hapori i ngā kape ātete me te kaha tuku ā-rohe.

depin.privacyTitle: Ka rongoa ngā kaihautū i ngā wāhanga, ehara i te uru.

depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Ka tirohia te mahi whai hua. Ko nga utu e noho ana i te rereketanga.
depin.hostBody: Ka mau tonu nga waehere ki nga waahanga whakamunatanga, ki nga waahanga taapiri ihirangi ranei i roto i te cache rohe kua herea. Ko te rokiroki o DeHub te puna o te pono.

depin.protectedContentBody: Ka taea te rokiroki i ngā wāhanga ohaurunga, tūmataiti, me te utu-per-view hei ciphertext. Kaore nga kaiwhakahaere Node e whiwhi i nga matua tika na te mea e manaaki ana i nga raraunga.
depin.publicContentBody: Ka ārai te whakamunatanga i te tirotiro tūponotanga o ngā kōnae cached, engari kei te mātakitaki tonu ngā pāpāho tūmatanui mā te kaitākaro DeHub tūmatanui. E kore matou e tono atu i te tahi atu.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Ka whiriwhiri ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā rohe kōpae, ngā rohe bandwidth, ngā haora mahi me ngā kāwai ihirangi tūmatanui e tika ana. Whakakorea nga panui e whakaoho ana i nga purges cache.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Kei te mahi nga poraka kua whakamanahia ki nga huihuinga takaro pono.
depin.availabilityBody: Ko nga tirotiro whakaora angitu me te ratonga pono i te wa e whakawhiwhia ana.
depin.validOutputBody: Me haere nga whakawhiti ki nga tirotiro kounga hangarau me te tauira.

depin.faqOfflineQ: He aha te mea ka tupu i te wa e haere ana te node manaaki i runga i te ipurangi?
depin.faqOfflineA: Ka tangohia e te kaiwhakahaere i te ara mahi. Ko tetahi atu replica e mahi ana i te waahanga, ko te playback ranei ka hoki mai ki te rokiroki o DeHub i te wa e whakaritea ana nga kape whakakapi.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Ka taea e te kaiwhakahaere node te kite i te ihirangi e manaaki ana ratou?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Kei te rokiroki ngā ihirangi tiaki hei wāhanga whakamunatanga, ā, kāore te kaihauturu e whiwhi i ngā kī tākaro. Kei te kitea tonu te ihirangi tūmatanui mā DeHub mā te hoahoa.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: E hia nga utu ka riro mai i te kaiwhakahaere node?
depin.faqHowMuchA: Kaore he utu tuuturu, he matapae ranei. Ka taea e te takoha kua whakamanahia te whiwhi i tetahi waahanga o te puna utu e utua ana i muri i te kati o te wa. Kaore e tiakina nga utu, a, ko te hiko, te bandwidth me nga utu taputapu ka nui ake i nga utu katoa.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Kei te wātea te pūmanawa node inaianei?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: He tiera ngawari, e hāngai ana i runga i te pūtirotiro e wātea ana i tenei ra: haina i roto, me te whiriwhiri i runga i tenei whārangi, a ka riro to koutou ripa tuwhera he node i te wa e tuwhera ana. He aronga papamahi nui ake, i nga wa katoa i runga i te papamahi he aronga heke mai kua whakahuatia — kaore ano kia noho.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: E hiahia ana ahau ki te tāuta i tetahi mea mo te pūtirotiro node?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: Kaore. Ka rere katoa i roto i te ripa ma te whakamahi i te rokiroki rohe o to kaitirotiro. Ko te kati i te ripa ka mutu to node; kaore he ratonga papamuri me te whakauru.
depin.appSignInBlurb: Hokona ki roto ki te kite i to koutou pūtirotiro node: te mea kua rokiroki koe, te mea kua tirohia, me te aha kua riro koe i tenei wā.
depin.appNodeBody: Ka rere te node i roto i te ripa pūtirotiro, e kore i roto i tenei taupānga. Whakatūwhera DePin i runga i te tukutuku, takiuru ki tenei pūkete, me te whiriwhiri i roto i. Ka puta mai tō kōpae i konei.

premium.diveBackgroundBody: Whakawetohia to waea, huri taupānga, peke ripa — ka takaro tonu to ataata me to puoro. Whakaarohia a DeHub hei taupānga pāpāho.
premium.diveAiTitle: AI ka taea e koe te whakawhirinaki
premium.diveAiBody: 500 karere Āwhina, 150 whakaahua AI, me te 20 hēkona o te ataata i hangaia ia marama. Ka nui ki te hanga, ki te tuku me te tuku — ehara i te kaiwhakaatu.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdQ: He aha te kaute hei panui i runga i a DeHub?
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: Ko nga pou whakatairanga i roto i to whangai, nga karaehe whakahou, me nga waahi tautoko i te Torotoro. Ka tangohia e Premium katoa.
premium.faqSwitchPlansQ: Ka taea e au te huri i waenga i te Extra me te Family?
premium.faqSwitchPlansA: Āe. Whakahouhia, whakahekehia ranei i nga wa katoa — ka utua aunoa te pire.
premium.faqFamilySeatsQ: Kei te pēhea te mahi o nga nohoanga whānau?
premium.faqFamilySeatsA: Ka tono te rangatira ki te 5 ingoa kaiwhakamahi DeHub. Ka mau tonu e ia mema tana ake kaute, tohu, me nga taumata — kaore he mea e kohia, e tohaina.
premium.faqTopTierStakerQ: He tino kaipupuri ahau. Me utu tonu ahau?
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: Kao. Ko nga taumata kaipupuri 7 runga ka whiwhi DeHub Extra mo te kore utu. Ko nga taumata 4 runga ka whiwhi DeHub Family mo te kore utu. Unstake ka ara ake nga perks — restake ka hoki mai.
premium.faqPayInDhbQ: Ka taea e au te utu ki ngā tohu DeHub?
premium.faqPayInDhbA: Ngā utu kāri i te whakarewanga. Kei te haere mai te utu ki ngā tohu DeHub, ā, ka whai utu whakaheke.

connect.title: Hono atu a DeHub ki tō kaiāwhina AI
connect.subtitle: Hoatu ki a ChatGPT, ki a Claude rānei te urunga ki DeHub — te tirotiro i ngā pānui, te pānui i ngā aho kōrero, te rapu me te tiro i ngā kōtaha — mā te whakapiri i te URL i raro ki ngā tautuhinga hononga o tō kaiāwhina.
connect.agentTitle: E hiahia ana koe kia whakairi, kia pōti, kia whakautu anō?
connect.agentBody: Mō te pānui anake te URL i runga. Waihangatia he māngai, ā, ka whiwhi koe i tōu ake URL hononga me te kī kei roto — he ōrite ngā hipanga, engari ka taea e te kaiāwhina te whakairi, te tākupu, te pōti me te whai hei māngai mōu.
connect.openSettings: Whakatuwhera i ngā tautuhinga hononga o {{app}}
connect.chatgptDevMode: Whakakāngia te aratau kaiwhakawhanake i ngā tautuhinga hononga (pānuihia te pānui tūraru e whakaaturia ana ki reira).
connect.chatgptComposer: I te tahua "+" o te pouaka kōrerorero, whakakāngia te aratau kaiwhakawhanake.
connect.chatgptAddSources: Kōwhiria Tāpiri pūtake, kātahi ko Hono atu anō.
connect.nameAndPaste: Tapaina te hononga ko "DeHub" ka whakapiri i te URL MCP i runga.
connect.askToUse: Tonoa a {{app}} kia whakamahi i a DeHub — hei tauira: "Whakaaturia mai ngā pānui rongonui i DeHub."
connect.claudeEnable: Whakakāngia te hononga mai i te pouaka kōrerorero o Claude, kātahi ka tono kia whakamahi i a DeHub.
connect.otherClients: He pērā anō te mahi a tētahi atu kiritaki e hāngai ana ki MCP — tāpirihia he tūmau MCP ritenga ka whakapiri i te URL i runga.
connect.guideTitle: Whakamahia a DeHub i roto i a {{app}}
connect.guideIntro: Kei te wātea a DeHub hei hononga taketake mō {{app}}. Whakakāngia kotahi te wā ka pātai ki a {{app}} mō ngā pānui, ngā kaihanga me ngā ia o DeHub — tōtika mai i te kōrerorero.
connect.step1Body: Pātōtohia te pātene i runga. Ka tuwhera tōtika a {{app}} ki te hononga DeHub i Tautuhinga → Hononga.
connect.step2Body: Whakakāngia a DeHub ka whakaae ki te urunga. Kātahi ka taea e {{app}} te pānui i ngā pānui tūmatanui, ngā kōtaha me ngā kaupapa rongonui o DeHub.
connect.step3Title: Tīmataria he kōrerorero hou ka whakamahi
connect.step3Body: Whakatuwherahia he kōrerorero hou ka whakahua i a DeHub i tō tono — ka karanga aunoa a {{app}} i te hononga.
connect.prompt1: Whakarāpopototia ngā pānui rongonui tekau o DeHub ināianei.
connect.prompt2: Kimihia ngā pānui i DeHub mō Bitcoin mai i ngā hāora 24 kua hori, ka hoatu he whakarāpopototanga.
connect.prompt3: Tirohia te kōtaha DeHub @satoshi ka kōrero mai he aha tāna i whakairi i tēnei wiki.
connect.faqFreeQ: He utu kore a DeHub i roto i a {{app}}?
connect.faqFreeA: Āe. He utu kore te hononga. Me tautoko tō mahere {{app}} i ngā hononga.
connect.faqWhatQ: He aha ngā mahi a te hononga DeHub?
connect.faqWhatA: Mā MCP ka taea e ia te tirotiro i ngā pānui tūmatanui o DeHub, te rapu kaupapa me te tiro i ngā kōtaha kaihanga. Kāore ia e whakairi mōu.
connect.chatgptFaqAccount: Kāore he pūkete e hiahiatia ana hei pānui i ngā kōrero tūmatanui mā te hononga. Me whai pūkete DeHub anake koe ki te hiahia koe ki te whakaputa, ki te hoatu ranei, ki te pupuri rānei i ngā tohu DeHub.
connect.claudeFaqAccount: Kāore. Ka taea te pānui i ngā kōrero tūmatanui me te kore he pūkete. Me whai pūkete DeHub anake koe ki te whakaputa, ki te hoatu ranei, ki te pupuri rānei i ngā tohu DeHub.

accountDeletion.title: Whakakorea te kaute
accountDeletion.description: Mukua tonu tō pūkete me ngā raraunga whaiaro
accountDeletion.warning: Ka mukua tonu e tēnei tō pūkete DeHub, pou, kōrero, karere me te tārua putea rokiroki. Tiaki koutou taipitopito whakaora putea, me te neke i tetahi rawa tuatahi. Kaore e taea te whakakore i nga whakawhitinga blockchain a te iwi me nga rekoata utu e hiahiatia ana e te ture. Kei te huna tonu tō pūkete; ka oti te whakakore i roto i te 30 ra. Kaore e taea te whakakore i tenei.
accountDeletion.busy: Te tuku i te tono whakakorenga...
accountDeletion.accepted: Te whakakore i te kaute i tonoa
accountDeletion.receipt: Kua ora tō tono whakakore. Kei te huna tō pūkete, ā, ka mukua tō pūkete i roto i te 30 ra. Kaore e taea e te takiuru te whakakore i tenei tono.
accountDeletion.error: Kaore e taea e au te tuku i to tono whakakore. Kaore i whakapumautia to kaute mo te whakakore. Tena koa tamata ano.
accountDeletion.acknowledge: Kua penapena e au aku taipitopito whakaora putea me te mohio he pumau te whakakore.

rules.title: Ture
rules.intro: Ka puta he mea ki runga i tō ripa, ka mahi a DeHub i tā koe whiriwhiri: ka whakaatu i te onagrams, ka whakatangi i te oro, ka pānui i te mea, ka tāpui ki tō kōrero, ki a Discord rānei.

polls.title: Pōtitanga
polls.intro: Tono i te hunga e titiro ana i tō whakaaturanga he pātai. Ka whakautu rātou mā te pōtini i roto i te taupānga DeHub, ā, mā te whakauru {{command}} me te nama o te whiringa i te korero.

moderation.intro: Ngā ture mō te kōrerorero i raro i ō awa katoa. Kaore ratou e tae ki te korerorero matua a DeHub: ka taea e tetahi e aukati ana koe i konei te korero i nga waahi katoa.

moderation.subscribersOnlyHint: Ko te hunga e whai ana i a ia anake.

moderation.wordAction: I te wa e whakamahi ana te tangata i tetahi
moderation.wordTimeout: Whakamutua te reira, me te wa ki a ratou mo te meneti
